dedupe_keys.name: holos whole farm greenhouse gas model

description: Holos is Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada's whole-farm model for estimating greenhouse-gas emissions and testing changes in farm management. It represents livestock feed, manure, cropping, tillage, energy, land use and shelterbelt carbon effects. Users enter a farm and alternative practices; outputs are estimated carbon-dioxide, methane and nitrous-oxide emissions for the chosen scenarios. Geography is a user-defined farm, with a Canadian implementation and separate international input guidance. The calculation period and farm resolution follow the supplied management records, not a national grid. The repository provides algorithm, input and user guides plus source code under GPL-3.0 at no charge. Its README says the downloadable Holos 4 graphical interface is not open source, so the GPL claim here applies to the repository code, not that GUI. A limitation is that an emissions estimate depends on local herd, soil and practice assumptions and is not a field measurement. Holos supports agricultural energy and emissions scenario studies. The catalogue's model-apsim-agricultural-production-systems-simulator is a distinct crop-systems model for comparison; no data exchange was tested. No installer or farm data was downloaded.
inputs: Farm livestock, crop, land, management and energy inputs
